instruction: Can you create a 3D model of a guitar? It should have six strings and a classic body shape.

-- MATERIAL LIBRARY --
body_wood | diffuse_color=(0.65, 0.35, 0.15, 1.0)
bridge_wood | diffuse_color=(0.15, 0.08, 0.02, 1.0)
fretboard_wood | diffuse_color=(0.10, 0.05, 0.02, 1.0)
metal_string | diffuse_color=(0.80, 0.80, 0.85, 1.0)
metal_tuning | diffuse_color=(0.90, 0.85, 0.60, 1.0)
#END_MATERIALS

# ----------  BEGIN_GRAPH  ----------
Layer 0 – Root
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
| neck_body_union | Composite union of neck_assembly + body_assembly | (1) execute 'neck_assembly': Align(XYZ) neck_assembly.bottom to body_assembly.top; (2) execute 'body_assembly': orientation=axis:+Z; mat=body_wood; create_method=boolean_subtract; constraint=body_shape_params { width=0.28m, height=0.45m, waist=0.18m, cutaway_depth=0.08m, thickness=0.05m, contour_radius=0.02m }; |

Layer 1 – Primary Structure
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
| body_assembly | Main guitar body (hollowed) | Align(XYZ) body_assembly.center to (0,0,0); orientation=axis:+Z; mat=body_wood; create_method=boolean_subtract; constraint=body_shape_params { width=0.28m, height=0.45m, waist=0.18m, cutaway_depth=0.08m, thickness=0.05m, contour_radius=0.02m }; |
| neck_assembly | Neck and headstock | Align(XYZ) neck_assembly.bottom to body_assembly.top; orientation=axis:+Z; mat=neck_wood; create_method=extrude_from_sketch; constraint=neck_profile_params { length=0.65m, width=0.045m, thickness=0.025m, headstock_angle=15deg, headstock_length=0.12m }; |

Layer 2 – Neck Details
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
| fretboard | Fretboard on neck | Align(XYZ) fretboard.bottom to neck_assembly.top; orientation=axis:+Z; mat=fretboard_wood; create_method=boolean_subtract; constraint=fretboard_params { length=0.60m, width=0.040m, thickness=0.005m, fret_count=22 }; |
| headstock | Headstock at top of neck | Align(XYZ) headstock.bottom to neck_assembly.top; orientation=axis:+Z; mat=neck_wood; create_method=extrude_from_sketch; constraint=headstock_params { length=0.12m, width=0.050m, thickness=0.020m, angle=15deg }; |

Layer 3 – Hardware & Strings
| ID | Description | Key attributes / placement |
| bridge | Bridge on body | Align(XYZ) bridge.bottom to body_assembly.top; orientation=axis:+Z; mat=bridge_wood; create_method=cylinder; constraint=bridge_params { diameter=0.015m, height=0.010m, position=(0.15m, -0.10m) }; |
| tuning_pegs | Tuning pegs on headstock | Align(XYZ) tuning_pegs.bottom to headstock.top; orientation=axis:+Z; mat=metal_tuning; create_method=cylinder; constraint=tuning_params { count=6, radius=0.005m, height=0.020m, positions=[(0.02m, 0.05m), (-0.02m, 0.05m), (0.02m, 0.03m), (-0.02m, 0.03m), (0.02m, 0.01m), (-0.02m, 0.01m)] }; |
| strings | Six guitar strings | Align(XYZ) strings.bottom to bridge.top; orientation=axis:+Z; mat=metal_string; create_method=cylinder; constraint=string_params { count=6, diameter=0.0005m, length=0.70m, positions=[(0.015m, -0.10m), (0.010m, -0.10m), (0.005m, -0.10m), (-0.005m, -0.10m), (-0.010m, -0.10m), (-0.015m, -0.10m)] }; |

# ----------  END_GRAPH  ----------

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix

# --- Helper Functions ---

def make_material(name, diffuse_color):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes["Principled BSDF"]
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = diffuse_color
    return mat

def add_text_object(text, size, location, rotation_euler):
    obj_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name=text, type='FONT')
    obj_data.body = text
    obj_data.size = size
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name=text, object_data=obj_data)
    obj.location = location
    obj.rotation_euler = rotation_euler

def boolean_subtract(cutter_name, target_name):
    cutter = bpy.data.objects[cutter_name]
    target = bpy.data.objects[target_name]
    
    # Ensure target is active for modifier addition
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = target
    
    # Add Boolean Modifier
    mod = target.modifiers.new(name="BooleanSub", type='BOOLEAN')
    mod.operation = 'DIFFERENCE'
    mod.object = cutter
    
    # Apply Modifier
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)
    
    # Remove cutter
    bpy.data.objects.remove(cutter, do_unlink=True)

def boolean_union(union_name, target_name):

    target = bpy.data.objects[target_name]

    mod = target.modifiers.new(name="BooleanUnion", type='BOOLEAN')

    mod.width = width

    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)

def align_axis_to_vector(obj, axis, vector):
    """Align object's local axis to a world vector."""
    if axis == 'X':
        src = Vector((1, 0, 0))
    elif axis == 'Y':
        src = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    elif axis == 'Z':
        src = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    
    # Normalize input vector
    vec = vector.normalized()
    
    # Calculate rotation matrix
    rot_mat = src.rotation_difference(vec).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    
    # Apply rotation
    obj.rotation_euler = rot_mat.to_euler()

def average(points):
    if not points:
        return Vector((0, 0, 0))
    avg = Vector((0, 0, 0))
    for p in points:
        avg += p
    return avg / len(points)

class Locator:
    def __init__(self, obj):
        self.obj = obj

    def center_world(self):
        return self.obj.location

    def face_center_world(self):
        # Assuming "face center" implies the center of the object's geometry
        # For simple primitives, this is the same as center_world
        return self.obj.location

    def radial_point_world(self, angle, radius):
        # Returns a point in the XY plane at a given angle and radius from the object's center
        x = radius * math.cos(angle)
        y = radius * math.sin(angle)
        z = 0
        return self.obj.location + Vector((x, y, z))

# Helper to create cutters and subtract
def create_and_subtract_waist_cutter(index, target_name):
    cutter_name = f"{target_name}_cut_waist{index}"
    # Cylinder diameter 0.04 m -> radius 0.02 m
    # Height 0.05 m
    # Anchor to target.center
    target = bpy.data.objects[target_name]
    anchor_loc = target.location
    
    # Create cutter
    cutter = add_cylinder(cutter_name, 0.02, 0.05, anchor_loc, (0, 0, 0))
    
    # Rotate cutter so its +Z axis aligns +Z (world)
    align_axis_to_vector(cutter, 'Z', Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    
    # Anchor cutter to target.center
    cutter.location = target.location
    
    # Move by offset(0,0,0)
    cutter.location += Vector((0, 0, 0))
    
    # Boolean subtract
    boolean_subtract(cutter_name, target_name)
